shortBulletSummary: Crypto Fear & Greed Index shows neutral sentiment, ranging between 48 and 55.
Federal Reserve held interest rates steady; however, two officials dissented seeking a hike, keeping inflation concerns alive.
Rising oil prices, with Brent crude at $116.72, are fueling inflation fears and influencing Bitcoin's price.
Moody's Analytics warns of a potential crypto market crash in the next 12-18 months due to leverage risks.
Ripple's USD stablecoin (RLUSD) has launched on Coinbase platforms, expanding access and utility.
